description: Icons of the v2 (Palworld-like) UI: notices (feed and headline), quest states, level-up stats, the nine elements of the monster book, and the tab menu. One set, tinted by the widgets.
style: Flat single-color game UI glyph: a pure white (#FFFFFF) silhouette on a fully transparent background. Bold, rounded, friendly shapes that read at 20 pixels, as a cheerful creature-collecting adventure game's HUD: strokes about a tenth of the icon's width, rounded ends and joins, no hairlines, no detail smaller than a stroke. No gradients, outlines, shadows, glow, perspective, text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks. Centered and optically balanced inside the padding. See Art/Style/ui_style.md.
